items.title: Cisco shares climb 4% on strong earnings beat and raised outlook
items.summary: Investing.com -- Cisco Systems Inc. shares surged 4% after the networking giant reported first-quarter fiscal 2027 results that comfortably beat analyst expectations and raised its full-year outlook, delivering its strongest revenue and earnings growth in more than 15 years.
